description: Reviewed exceptions: reference periods for which no DMI observation is published, and why. scripts.finalize_release refuses to publish a release that follows an unpublished month not listed here, and release summaries name each listed month with its reason. Every entry is added by hand in a reviewed pull request, never by the pipeline. Listing a period publishes nothing and estimates nothing.

periods.reason: the required official CPI comparison data are unavailable
periods.detail: BLS did not publish October 2025 CPI because of the 2025 lapse in federal government appropriations. October 2025 is the 12-month base month for October 2026 inflation, and BLS states it will not publish October 2026 12-month percent changes for indexes where October 2025 data are not available, so the October 2026 DMI cannot be computed. It is not estimated, interpolated or backfilled.

sources.title: BLS, Consumer Price Index Archived News Releases (October 2025: "Not published because of 2025 lapse in federal government appropriations")
